requirements.description: A successful dependency response preserves content; permanent failures stop without retry; transient failures have at most three total attempts.
A total two-second budget covers all attempts. Caller cancellation remains distinct from deadline expiry and is forwarded to in-flight transport.
Public response members Status and Content and the declared status values remain compatible; degraded output is distinguishable from success.
Shared breakers block unhealthy calls, allow a recovery probe, and reject concurrent recovery probes. Concurrency limits bound admitted callbacks.
